_instructions: Keep eras, composers, main pieces, and additional pieces in the exact display order wanted on the page.
Each composer requires composer and main. Put optional secondary works in additional; omit additional when empty.
Use catalogue-style titles such as "Symphony No. 1 in E major, Op. 26"; do not append composition years unless they are part of the established work title.
Store only the 11-character YouTube video ID in video. iframeTitle is the accessible player title. note may be plain text or a parts object containing text and linked text.
